prompt_head:
Job: Solutions Architect at Smartsheet
<requirements>
- (required) 3 years relevant work experience or equivalent combination of relevant work experience and ed

output.angle: Position Tylor as a hands-on AI systems architect who has shipped LLM agent pipelines end to end and brings customer-facing onboarding and integration experience to enterprise SaaS work.
posting_hooks: Familiarity with AI/LLM technologies integrated into applications via APIs, backed by the LangGraph agent and LLM eval suite Tylor shipped with CI gates
Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, used for orchestrator and sub-agent workflows
Data integration of SaaS applications with business systems (ETL, CRM, reporting), shown by the Google Sheets CRM pipeline and database-layer validation pipelines
